cd /code && mkdir -p ../results && Rscript - <<'RS'
rec <- read.csv('../data/rec_data_raw.csv', header=TRUE)
us <- subset(rec, country=='us' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))
uk <- subset(rec, country=='uk' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))
out <- data.frame(country=c('US','UK'), institutions_sampled=c(nrow(us), nrow(uk)))
write.csv(out, '../results/institutions_sampled.csv', row.names=FALSE)
print(out)
RS
